items.boundary: Version-bound qualitative summary; method and claim audit, not experiment reproduction.

summary_override.summary_en: Execution and validation feedback select solver edits together with instructions for subsequent investigation, retaining accepted instructions for later rounds while the model and executable supervisor stay fixed. Inclusion rests on instruction-policy evolution; the solver is a task artifact. Developers have seen test results, and a better final program does not establish a better improver.
summary_override.summary_zh: 执行与验证反馈共同筛选数值求解器及后续调查指令，并把通过的指令保留到下一轮；模型与可执行监督器固定。纳入依据是指令策略迭代，求解器本身属于任务产物。作者已接触测试结果，最终程序变好不等于改进器变强。

items.boundary: Version-bound qualitative summary; method and claim audit, not experiment reproduction.

summary_override.summary_en: Uses tool execution and inspection to revise Actor and Evaluator instructions, rubrics and skills, retaining them across improvement rounds; adoption requires support from fresh output. Model weights stay fixed. Harnesses and history reset between independent tasks, so cross-task transfer and sustained long-term improvement remain untested.
summary_override.summary_zh: 通过工具执行与核查共同修改 Actor 和 Evaluator 的指令、评判规则及技能，保留到后续改进轮次；提议须由新输出支持。模型权重固定，独立任务之间重置 Harness 与历史，跨任务迁移及长期持续改进尚未验证。

items.boundary: Version-bound qualitative summary; method and claim audit, not experiment reproduction.

summary_override.summary_en: Optimizes capability-routing instructions for reasoning, retrieval and tools from feedback, then reuses the retained prompts on later queries to study routing and downstream behavior. Some downstream data overlap earlier data and labels were revised after analysis. Reported savings omit router overhead and the measurements use different environments, so they are not end-to-end cost or latency gains.
summary_override.summary_zh: 用反馈优化推理、检索和工具能力的路由指令，再将保留的提示用于后续查询，比较路由质量与下游表现。部分下游数据与前序数据重叠且标签事后修正；所列节省不含路由器开销，两部分测量环境不同，不能当作端到端成本或延迟收益。

items.boundary: Version-bound qualitative summary; method and claim audit, not experiment reproduction.

summary_override.summary_en: Develops a theory for persistent adoption of generated prompt, tool and workflow configurations: freeze a candidate, audit it with fresh observations and prespecified metrics, and constrain degradation relative to a reference. Evidence comes from synthetic statistical experiments, not a real-agent study; guarantees depend on sampling, evaluation validity and target-distribution assumptions.
summary_override.summary_zh: 提出自生成提示、工具和工作流配置的持久准入理论：先冻结候选，再以新鲜审计样本和预定指标决定采纳，并约束相对参考版本的退化。证据来自合成统计实验，尚无真实 Agent 实证；保证受抽样、评估有效性与目标分布假设限制。

items.boundary: Version-bound qualitative summary; method and claim audit, not experiment reproduction.

summary_override.summary_en: Compiles and retains protocol instructions from failure types in training trajectories, then freezes them for reuse across test questions; a skill library also evolves from feedback. Harness inclusion is limited to the protocol-prompt component. Templates and the execution mechanism stay fixed, retrieved skills are disabled on most datasets, and overall gains cannot all be attributed to hypergraph skill evolution. Counterfactual admission uses model judgments.
summary_override.summary_zh: 根据训练轨迹的失败类型组合并保留协议指令，冻结后在测试问题间复用；技能库另按反馈演化。Harness 纳入限于协议提示组件，模板和执行机制固定，多数数据集关闭检索技能注入，不能把整体收益全归超图技能演化。反事实准入使用模型判断。

items.boundary: Version-bound qualitative summary; method and claim audit, not experiment reproduction.

summary_override.summary_en: Human experts iteratively revise diagnostic rules, judge skills and an override gate against prespecified target and control cases, retaining accepted Harness versions and checking a session-disjoint evaluation split. This is a human-guided Harness-improvement evaluation. No approved knowledge change has been merged and re-indexed in the deployed corpus, so it does not establish autonomous production repair.
summary_override.summary_zh: 人工专家按预定目标与控制案例迭代诊断规则、judge 技能和覆盖门，保留通过检查的 Harness 版本，并用按会话分开的评估集检查。属于人工引导的 Harness 改进评测；已部署知识库尚无获批合并及重建索引，不能称生产系统已自主修复。

items.boundary: Version-bound qualitative summary; method and claim audit, not experiment reproduction.

summary_override.summary_en: A human-supervised migration study selects prompt paragraphs and Harness fixes using prespecified checks and Oracle execution results, retaining revisions across versions; memory and strategy-ranker experiments are separate. The same corpus is repeatedly used for debugging and changes in size; raw artifacts remain internal, so this is not evidence of autonomous improvement or independent holdout validation.
summary_override.summary_zh: 迁移实验中的人工监督循环以预先写定的检查条件和 Oracle 执行结果筛选提示段与 Harness 修复，保留到后续版本；与记忆和策略 ranker 实验分开。同一语料反复参与调试且规模变化，原始工件未公开，不能当作自主改进或独立留出集验证。

items.boundary: Historical backlog at current v1 only; no version upgrade or later-version numbers.

summary_override.summary_en: A preregistered evaluation compares simple configurations around frozen models, a rescue configuration and GEPA-selected prompts to examine whether Harness-search gains come from answer parseability, baseline choice or evaluation defects. Injected-defect comparisons show that replication through the same pipeline can reproduce a defect’s distortion instead of revealing it.
summary_override.summary_zh: 预注册评测比较冻结模型周围的简单配置、救援配置与 GEPA 选出的提示，追查 Harness 搜索增益究竟来自答案可解析性、基线选择还是评测缺陷。注入缺陷的对照显示，使用同一管线进行复制可能复现缺陷的影响，而不能揭示它。
